workflow: Generate one identity-preserving calm master from existing emergency artwork; edit that same master separately for every variant using built-in image_gen. Final PNGs are direct generated outputs, without downscaling, pixelation filters, hand-painted facial patches or code-generated character geometry. Failed confident alpha extraction and a smoothed retry were rejected; the final confident expression was regenerated from the calm master.

integration.usage: Use each PNG's imported Sprite subasset directly. Keep the same RectTransform, size and pivot across expressions; do not auto-crop to alpha bounds or invoke per-expression SetNativeSize. Scene hookup is outside this asset-only task.

review.identity: Original high ponytail, brown eyes, red hair ribbon and sash, teal vest/cuffs, ivory sleeves/collar and gold edging retained. All seven derive from one approved master.
review.appeal: More expressive eyes/brows, beautiful mature face, refined hair and cloth shading, confident hand-on-hip pose, affectionate teasing vs focused teacher contrast; no revealing clothing or sexualized pose.
review.transparency: Composited all seven over ivory, white and dark slate. Rejected visible smoky alpha remnants in the first confident output. Final PNGs retain generated alpha; the numeric report includes a negligible 1-2/255 alpha fringe at some canvas-border pixels.
review.consistency: Same 1024x1536 canvas and bottom-center pivot. RGB patch matching in fixed hair and sash regions found at most 1 source pixel displacement per axis from Calm. These are consistent edited illustrations, not bit-identical bodies; small texture and contour differences remain.
review.readability: Inspected full portraits at 384px height and face crops at 1:1. Expressions remain distinct at 384px. At 192px and smaller, fine differences between neutral and confident become less obvious; dialogue display should use a larger portrait.
review.harmony: Static composite with the unchanged LessonRoom, SettingsPanel and BrushTitle: muted teal, cinnabar, ivory and warm brown align with timber/hanji and ink accents; clear dark contours separate the character from the pale room.
review.scope: Asset imports and static art composites were verified. No Play Mode scenario, gameplay tests or player build were run; no dialogue, scene, story, chart, training or judgment implementation was changed.
